name: Minami Alps National Park
description: National park (1964) of the southern Japan Alps — the country's deepest wilderness, centered on Kitadake (3,193 m, Japan's second-highest peak) and Senjogatake.
notes: Designated 1964 (35,752 ha). Serious hiking country; the Hirogawara and Notori trails are the standard approaches.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
